LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 9.1.1 NAMING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Observing and Articulating signs 9.1.1 Naming
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 9.1.1 Naming, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we go to school and back home? 2. How do people move from one place to another?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 9.1.1 Naming together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: cooperation as learner interacts with others to discuss how different means of transport move.

● Patriotism: citizenship as learner becomes aware of the different means of transport within and outside their country

and this develops the learner’s love of their own country.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety and security issues awareness as learner is made to understand on the need of being careful while using any means

of transport since accidents do occur along roads, air, water, foot paths.

Link to other Learning Areas:

All learning areas requires identification of various items.
